product_one_liner.value: Upstage provides large language models and intelligent document-processing tools that help enterprises extract information and automate business workflows.

employee_band.notes: Dealroom lists 201–500 employees; the Korean company page says the team exceeds 200.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts explain WriteUp quantization and engine optimization, and Solar Open 2 training and weight transfer; author job titles are not explicitly stated.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes models, deployment options, capabilities and API references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI Engineer - LLM Serving Platform appears on the current openings board.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public claims on the on-premises pricing page.

last_funding.notes: Latest announced participation: NVIDIA on November 9, 2026, in the ongoing Series C-2; its amount was undisclosed and finalization remained pending. JB Financial's initial $27.2 million investment was announced October 20; that is not an established total for the ongoing round.

raised_18mo.notes: The completed $45 million Series B bridge was announced August 20, 2025, within the specified 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An SDR (Sales Development Representative), one-year contract role, is listed with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Upstage Studio launched October 6, 2026, within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A March 6, 2026 report announced the recruitment of Jin Yoon-jung (진윤정) as CFO, with joining planned for late March.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting names Salesforce and HubSpot experience; the privacy policy identifies Salesforce, Attio, Apollo.io and Brevo for customer management, lead enrichment or marketing email. HubSpot is a hiring signal, not confirmed deployment.
